source_artifacts.claim: Light cargo can hold the ANY BRAKE pad, which stops, powers and opens the ferry route. Pac holds STEADY for the bridge and opens Isp bridge gate; Isp reaches latched RESCUE, which powers ferry and opens both island and finish doors while stabilizing bridge. Ferry has 5s powered/3s paused cycle; bridge collapses after 0.8s without support and resets in 2s. Slime occupies gaps.
